claims.claim: The query is a pyrido[2,3-d]pyrimidinone 2-anilino derivative with a piperazinyl-pyridinyl solubilizing group, structurally analogous to the 2-anilinopyrimidine kinase inhibitors brigatinib and GSK1322322, which show absolute oral bioavailability of 46% (C14), 77% fed (C04), and 57% fasted (C15) in healthy volunteers, all above the 20% threshold.

New L2 context reinforces brigatinib oral bioavailability: C19 reports high solubility and permeability with oral bioavailability, and C23 describes brigatinib as orally bioavailable, directly addressing the permeability concern in the physicochemical prior.

New L2 rat data for the piperazine-containing heteroaromatic TDP223206 show absolute bioavailability of 24.46% at 50 mg/kg (C25) and 32.95% at 10 mg/kg (C28), both above the 20% threshold, so even the least favorable context does not affirmatively support F below 20%.

No new card provides affirmative threshold-relevant evidence of F below 20% for the query chemotype; paliperidone ER at 28% (C03, C16) with a low and variable descriptor (C22) remains above the threshold and belongs to a different scaffold.
